_comment: ADR-0036. Objects committed migrations DECLARE that are legitimately absent from prod. Shrink-only. Every entry is verified fail-closed at run time: the gate FAILS if an allowlisted object is actually PRESENT in prod (a stale waiver must not mask a real object), and FAILS if a key names no active category. Two kinds of entry, both documented in _reasons: (1) INTENTIONAL design drift (superseded / renamed / dropped out of band; may be permanent); (2) KNOWN pre-existing PROD DRIFT pending reconciliation — a committed migration whose object is not yet in prod. Burn (2) to zero by applying the fix in prod (Supabase Dashboard -> SQL Editor); once the object exists, the stale-waiver tripwire FORCES the entry's removal. NEVER add here to silence NEW drift. Format: { "<kind>": ["identifier", ...] } where identifier matches the gate's derived form: tables/types bare-lowercase; rls_enabled/trigger/column `public.…`; index `table.index`; policy `public.table :: Name` (policy name case-preserved).
policy: public.project_roster :: Members can view own roster entries

_reasons.tickets/ticket_events (+ ticket_inbox_ty: INTENTIONAL. The May 2026 chatwoot ticket design (migration 20260509160635), superseded by support_ticket_events (June redesign); 0 references in the app; never applied to prod.
_reasons.DRIFT-A 20260625120000_fleety_rearchitec: PENDING RECONCILE. This migration only partially reached prod: its tables/columns/pkeys/policies/RLS exist, but fleety_synonyms_status_idx, fleety_user_memory_user_active_idx, the two *_updated_at triggers, and fleety_examples.promoted_from_turn_id/promoted_at do NOT. Effect of the gap: updated_at is not auto-maintained on fleety_synonyms/fleety_user_memory, two secondary indexes are missing, and nugget-promotion provenance columns are missing. The migration is marked idempotent and safe to re-run. REMEDIATION: re-run 20260625120000_fleety_rearchitecture.sql in prod (Dashboard SQL Editor), then delete these 6 entries.
PENDING DECISION. Migration 20260520035733 CREATEs stats_drift_log with delta (GENERATED ALWAYS AS (actual - expected) STORED) + auto_recomputed; prod's table lacks both (created earlier/differently, so CREATE IF NOT EXISTS no-op'd). REMEDIATION: ALTER TABLE public.stats_drift_log ADD these two columns in prod, OR (if prod's 6-column shape is canonical) forward-fix the migration; then remove.
_reasons.DRIFT-C public.request_idempotency.statu: PENDING DECISION — likely a MIGRATION MISTAKE. Migration 20260603000800 re-CREATEs request_idempotency (IF NOT EXISTS) with a `status` text column, but the earlier 20260602230329 already created it with `status_code`, so the redefinition silently no-op'd; prod has status_code. Decide the canonical name: if status_code (recommended — matches prod and the first migration), the `status` declaration is the bug and this waiver stays / the migration is forward-fixed; else ALTER prod to add status. ALSO verify the complete_idempotency() function body in prod writes the column prod actually has.
_reasons.DRIFT-D public.project_roster :: Members: PENDING DECISION — access-changing. Migration 20260415024855 adds a SELECT policy letting members read their OWN roster rows; prod has only 'Admins can manage roster'. May have been intentionally withheld. REMEDIATION: if members should see their own entries, apply the policy in prod; else keep waived (or remove the statement forward). Then remove.
